blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Many localized large language model (LLM) unlearning methods select a small parameter subset from a localization signal and keep it fixed during optimization. The parameters most associated with a target, however, need not be the best ones to update, and candidate interventions can change value as optimization proceeds. In a controlled experiment, a storage-localization score reaches an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.981 0.981 , yet storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17 / 36 17/36 targets, while low-rank adaptation (LoRA) wins 35 / 36 35/36 . We introduce Intervention Score , which ranks editable groups by the predicted effect of the actual unlearning update while accounting for collateral damage, and use it to form the static intervention-value baseline ( Static-IV ). We then introduce selective dynamic intervention re-ranking ( DIR-R ), which revisits that subset only when a calibrated probe justifies the comparison. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, our method has positive descriptive margins in 19 / 20 19/20 comparisons between methods and objectives, although several are near zero. On the LACUNA localization-precision benchmark, our mean terminal utility is higher in all six negative preference optimization (NPO) and SimNPO comparisons: NPO margins range from + 0.431 +0.431 to + 0.848 +0.848 , and SimNPO margins range from + 0.503 +0.503 to + 0.571 +0.571 . The gradient-difference (GradDiff) objective reveals substantial field dependence. Relative to Static-IV , the primary four-field GradDiff evaluation has six wins, six ties, and no losses, with mean and median paired gains of + 0.165 +0.165 and + 0.0025 +0.0025 . The evidence supports separating localization, initial intervention selection, and checkpoint-dependent support revision.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Machine unlearning studies how to remove the effect of specified training data from a trained model while preserving utility on data that should be retained ( Cao and Yang, 2015 ; Bourtoule et al., 2021 ) . A natural reference is retraining without the data to be forgotten, but retraining is prohibitively expensive for LLMs ( Maini et al., 2024 ; Shi et al., 2025 ) . Practical LLM unlearning therefore modifies an existing model in place. Recent work develops direct gradient objectives and preference losses, including negative preference optimization (NPO) and its reference-free simplification SimNPO ( Jang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2025b ) . A complementary line asks where the update should act. Localized LLM unlearning selects a small parameter subset from localization or attribution signals and restricts optimization to that subset ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 机器不学习研究如何从经过培训的模型中去除特定培训数据的效果,同时保留对应当保留的数据的效用(曹和杨,2015年;Bourtoule等人,2021年). 一个自然的参照点是没有被遗忘的数据的再培训,但对LLMS来说再培训费用高昂(Maini等人,2024年;Shi等人,2025年)。 实用 因此,LLM不学习修改了现有的模式。 最近的工作制定了直接的梯度目标和优惠损失,包括负面优惠优化(NPO)及其无参考的简化SimNPO(Jang等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2024年;Fan等人,2025年b). 补充的一行问更新应在哪里行动。 本地化的LLM unlearning从本地化或归属信号中选择一个小参数子集,并限制优化到该子集(Jia等人,2024年;Tian等人,2024年;Guo等人,2025年;Lee等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Localization-first designs often rely on two operational assumptions. The first treats localization-derived importance as a proxy for where a particular unlearning objective should intervene, although localization quality does not necessarily predict intervention efficacy ( Hase et al., 2023 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) . The second keeps the selected parameter subset fixed as optimization proceeds, even though continual-unlearning work adapts masks dynamically and post-training analysis warns that static mechanistic localization can become stale as parameters evolve ( Wuerkaixi et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026 ) . We therefore separate the initial intervention subset from the decision to revise it after optimization changes the model.
blocks.zh: 本地化-第一设计往往依赖两个操作假设. 第一种观点将本地化的重要性视为某一非学习目标应干预的代名词,尽管本地化质量不一定预测干预效果(Hase等人,2023年;Lee等人,2025年)。 第二种方法将选定的参数子集固定为优化收益,尽管持续学习的工作能动态地调整口罩,培训后的分析警告说,随着参数的演变,静态机械化可以变得停滞(Wuerkaixi等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年)。 因此,我们将初始干预子集与在优化后修改其模式的决定分开。

blocks.en: Our controlled experiment directly tests the first assumption by separating localization accuracy from intervention effectiveness. We construct synthetic facts for which the parameter interface used to inject each fact is known by design. A storage-localization score identifies this known interface with AUROC 0.981 0.981 and residualized AUROC 0.926 0.926 , indicating accurate localization. Yet it predicts the better intervention on only 17 17 of 36 36 targets, while an alternative LoRA interface ( Hu et al., 2022 ) achieves the better outcome on 35 35 of 36 36 . Accurate localization does not by itself identify where a particular unlearning objective should intervene. This choice is also objective-dependent. On our Natural-TOFU setting, derived from TOFU ( Maini et al., 2024 ) , equal-size subsets selected independently under NPO and SimNPO ( Zhang et al., 2024 ; Fan et al., 2025b ) have a Jaccard overlap of about 0.143 0.143 . Both observations motivate choosing the initial subset according to the expected effect of the actual update instead of localization alone. Running every candidate intervention to completion would be prohibitively expensive, so we introduce Intervention Score as an efficient proxy. The score estimates how the update induced by the chosen objective would act on each group. It rewards predicted forgetting, penalizes predicted damage to retained and protected behavior, and discounts nonspecific model changes. Ranking under a fixed parameter budget yields an objective-conditioned initial subset. Keeping it fixed defines Static-IV and isolates initial selection quality. Because even a strong initial subset can become less suitable as the model changes, selective DIR-R revisits it at a later checkpoint and runs the complete continuation comparison only when a calibrated probe indicates potential value.
blocks.zh: 我们的受控实验直接测试了第一个假设,将定位精度与干预效果区分开来. 我们构建合成事实,用于注入每个事实的参数界面通过设计而为人所知. 一个存储-本地化分数识别出这个已知的与AUROC 0.981 0.981和残存的AUROC 0.926 0.926的接口,表示准确本地化. 然而,它预测36个目标中只有17个17个目标得到更好的干预,而另一个LORA接口(Hu等人,2022年)则在36个目标中的35个取得了更好的结果。 准确的本地化本身并不确定某一未学习目标应在何处干预。 这种选择也依赖客观。 在我们的自然-TOFU设定中,从TOFU(Maini等人,2024年)中独立选定了NPO和SimNPO(Zhang等人,2024年;Fan等人,2025年b)的等大小子集,Jaccard重叠约0.1430.143。 这两个观测都激励着根据实际更新的预期效果选择初始子集,而不只是本地化. 将每个候选干预进行到完成将极为昂贵,因此我们引入干预计分作为有效的代用。 得分估计选定目标引起的更新将如何对每个组采取行动。 它奖励预言的遗忘,惩罚预言的对保留和保护行为的损害,并折扣非特定模式的改变. 在固定参数预算下排名产生一个客观条件的初始子集。 保持固定定义静态-IV并隔离初始选择质量. 因为即使是强的初始子集也会随着模型的改变而变得不太合适,选择性的DIR-R在后来的检查点重新审视它,并且仅在一个校准的探测器显示潜在值时进行完整的续作比较.

blocks.en: We evaluate the two decisions in complementary settings. On the Natural-TOFU dataset, Intervention Score with DIR-R is compared with ten parameter-selection baselines under NPO and SimNPO; its descriptive mean margins are positive in 19 / 20 19/20 comparisons, with several close to zero. The LACUNA localization-precision benchmark ( Boglioni et al., 2026 ) provides direct comparisons with selected baselines. After selecting three objective-specific baselines from a ten-method panel, our method has higher mean terminal utility in all six NPO and SimNPO comparisons. NPO margins range from + 0.431 +0.431 to + 0.848 +0.848 , and SimNPO margins range from + 0.503 +0.503 to + 0.571 +0.571 . GradDiff exposes a boundary: static parameter-subset rankings change substantially across data fields, and several static methods remain ahead in the complete four-field primary. In the DIR-R ablation, the aggregate mean difference relative to Static-IV is positive in all six evaluation sets; the primary GradDiff evaluation has mean gain + 0.1646 +0.1646 , median paired gain + 0.0025 +0.0025 , and six wins, six ties, and no losses. The results treat initial selection and checkpoint-dependent revision as distinct empirical questions without claiming uniform dominance.
blocks.zh: 我们在互补的环境中评估这两项决定。 在Natural-TOFU数据集上,将DIR-R的干预得分与NPO和SimNPO下的10个参数选择基线进行比较;其描述性平均比值在19 / 20 19/20的比较中为正比值,几个参数接近零。 LACUNA本地化-精度基准(Boglioni等人,2026年)提供与选定基线的直接比较。 在从一个十种方法的面板中选择了三个针对特定目标的基线之后,我们的方法在所有六个NPO和SimNPO的比较中具有更高的平均终端效用. NPO的幅度从+0.431+0.431到+0.848+0.848,SimNPO的幅度从+0.503+0.503到+0.571+0.571. GradDiff暴露了一条边界:静态参数-子集的排列在数据字段之间发生了实质性的变化,在完整的四战区主线中,几种静态方法仍然领先. 在DIR-R偏差中,相对于静态IV的总平均差值在所有6套评价中都是正数;初级GradDiff评价有平均增益+0.1646+0.1646,中位配对增益+0.0025+0.0025,6胜6负,无亏损. 结果将初步选择和依赖检查站的修订视为独特的经验性问题,而不主张统一的支配地位。

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • A controlled separation of localization and intervention. We show that highly accurate storage localization need not identify the better unlearning intervention: despite storage AUROC 0.981 0.981 , storage identity agrees with the better intervention on only 17 / 36 17/36 targets. • Objective-conditioned initial parameter selection. We introduce Intervention Score and its fixed-subset realization Static-IV . Against ten parameter-selection methods under NPO and SimNPO on the Natural-TOFU dataset, Intervention Score with DIR-R has positive descriptive margins in 19 / 20 19/20 comparisons. • Checkpoint-dependent support revision. We introduce selective DIR-R , which conditionally revisits the initial subset rather than recomputing alternatives throughout optimization. The LACUNA benchmark reports positive mean margins in all six NPO and SimNPO baseline comparisons, while the ablation of DIR-R against Static-IV has a positive aggregate mean difference in every reported evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:——有控制地将本地化和干预分开。 我们显示,高度准确的存储本地化无需确定更好的未学习干预:尽管存储AUROC 0.981 0.981,但存储身份同意仅对17/36 17/36目标进行更好的干预。 • 客观条件的初步参数选择。 我们引入干预分数 及其固定子集实现 Static-IV。 与NPO和SimNPO在自然-TOFU数据集下的10个参数选择方法相比,DIR-R的干预得分在19/2019/20比较中具有积极的描述幅度。 • 依赖检查站的支助修订。 我们引入了选择性的DIR-R,它有条件地重新审视了初始子集,而不是在整个优化过程中重新计算替代品。 拉加联合国协会基准报告,在所有六个本国专业干事和辛普罗基线比较中,平均差值均为正差,而DIR-R与Static-IV的比值则在每一套报告的评价中,平均差值为正数。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Classical machine unlearning studies deletion-efficient learning, certified removal, selective forgetting, and retraining-oriented guarantees ( Ginart et al., 2019 ; Guo et al., 2020 ; Golatkar et al., 2020 ; Sekhari et al., 2021 ) . LLM-specific work extends this setting with privacy-oriented dememorization, direct parameter updates, representation-level removal, parameter-efficient methods, causal formulations, and inference-time alternatives ( Kassem et al., 2023 ; Chen and Yang, 2023 ; Ji et al., 2024 ; Yao et al., 2024 ; Pawelczyk et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2024 ; Cha et al., 2025 ; Ding et al., 2025 ; Gao et al., 2025 ) . Evaluation work additionally stresses that apparent forgetting can be fragile under stronger metrics, obfuscation tests, or relearning ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Fan et al., 2025a ) . Our work fixes the unlearning objective and studies a different decision: which parameters that objective should update, and whether that choice should later change.
blocks.zh: 古典机器不学习研究删除效率高的学习,认证删除,选择性遗忘,以及再培训导向的保障(Ginart等人,2019年;Guo等人,2020年;Golatkar等人,2020年;Sekhari等人,2021年). LLM特异性的工作将这一设置延伸为面向隐私的去模化,直接参数更新,表示层去除,参数高效方法,因果配体,以及推论时间的替代品(Kassem等人,2023年;Chen and Yang,2023年;Ji等人,2024年;姚等人,2024年;Pawelczyk等人,2024年;Liu等人,2024年). 2024年;Cha等人,2025年;Ding等人,2025年;Gao等人,2025年). 评价工作还强调指出,在更强有力的衡量标准、模糊测试或重新学习的情况下,明显的遗忘可能很脆弱(Hu等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年;Fan等人,2025年a) 。 我们的工作确定了不学习的目标,并研究了不同的决定:哪些参数应更新这一目标,以及这一选择是否应在以后改变。

blocks.en: Model editing uses direct parameter modification, learned editors, retrieval mechanisms, or localized weight updates to change factual behavior ( De Cao et al., 2021 ; Mitchell et al., 2022a ; Mitchell et al., 2022b ; Meng et al., 2022 ; Meng et al., 2023 ) ; later work further questions static fact-level localization assumptions ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Localized unlearning inherits the same tension. WAGLE and MemFlex choose update regions from attribution or gradient evidence ( Jia et al., 2024 ; Tian et al., 2024 ) , while mechanistic and benchmark studies test how localization affects robustness and intervention efficacy ( Guo et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2025 ; Boglioni et al., 2026 ) . We treat localization evidence as an input to an intervention decision rather than as the decision target itself.
blocks.zh: 模型编辑采用直接参数修改,学习编辑,检索机制,或本地化重量更新改变事实行为(De Cao等人,2021年;Mitchell等人,2022年a年;Mitchell等人,2022年b年;Meng等人,2022年;Meng等人,2023年);后期工作进一步质疑静态事实层面本地化假设. (陈等,2025). 本地化的不学习继承了同样的紧张. WAGLE和MemFlex从归属或梯度证据中选择更新区域(Jia等人,2024年;Tian等人,2024年),而机械和基准研究则测试本地化如何影响稳健性和干预效果(Guo等人,2025年;Lee等人,2025年;Boglioni等人,2026年). 我们把本地化的证据视为干预决定的投入,而不是决定本身的目标。

3.2 From localization to intervention selection
blocks.zh: 3.2 从本地化到干预选择

blocks.en: A localization method asks which parameter groups are associated with the information to be forgotten. That is a descriptive question. Choosing a support asks a different question: if the same unlearning procedure is allowed to update only a particular set of groups, which choice leads to the best terminal outcome? A group may therefore receive a strong localization signal without being the best place to intervene under the actual objective, budget, and optimization trajectory.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 6 讨论和限制

blocks.en: Our results distinguish parameter localization from the downstream decision of where an unlearning objective should act. The controlled experiment makes this distinction explicit: the injected interface can be identified accurately, yet this information does not predict the better intervention. The parameter-selection comparisons further show that intervention quality depends on the objective and data field. These results do not imply that localization is uninformative; rather, they indicate that localization evidence alone is not a sufficient decision criterion for selecting an editable subset.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果将参数本地化与下游决定一个未学习目标应在何处行动区分开来。 受控实验明确了这种区分:可以准确识别注入的接口,然而这些信息并不能预测更好的干预. 参数选择比较进一步表明,干预质量取决于目标和数据领域。 这些结果并不意味着本地化是非信息化的;相反,它们表明,本地化证据本身并不是选择可编辑子集的充分决定标准.

blocks.en: The evidence also has several important boundaries. Natural-TOFU margins for Intervention Score + DIR-R combine results from different final evaluation sets and therefore are not direct paired estimates. Natural GradDiff uses held-out trace replay rather than the confirmation evaluation set. For LACUNA GradDiff, the four-field result is the primary endpoint: several static parameter-selection methods remain ahead of DIR-R, and the three-field analysis excluding Birth City is a sensitivity analysis. We therefore interpret it as evidence of field heterogeneity rather than as a replacement superiority result.
blocks.zh: 证据也有几个重要的界限. 干预分数的自然-TOFU差值+DIR-R结合了不同最终评价组的结果,因此不是直接对数估计数。 Natural GradDiff使用持有的痕量重播而非确认评价集. 对于LACUNA GradDiff,四场结果为主终点:几种静态参数选择方法仍然领先于DIR-R,排除出生城的三场分析是灵敏度分析. 因此,我们把它解释为实地异质性的证据,而不是替代优越性的结果。

blocks.en: Finally, DIR-R searches only within a frozen family of equal-budget continuation candidates. Its exhaustive comparisons identify the best continuation within that family, not the globally optimal editable subset. The gate trades additional computation for continuation gain: the 16 × 16\times exhaustive multi-checkpoint construction is a normalized step-equivalent reference rather than a wall-clock measurement, and the appropriate balance between compute and gain may vary across objectives and deployment settings.
blocks.zh: 最后,DIR-R只在冻结的同等预算续聘候选人家庭内进行搜索。 其详尽无遗的比较确定了该家庭中的最佳延续性,而不是全球最佳的可编辑子集。 闸门交易额外的计算以获得继续收益:16×16的详尽多检查点构建是一种正常的步数等同参考,而不是一个时钟测量,计算和收益之间的适当平衡可能因目标和部署设置而异.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Localized LLM unlearning involves two decisions that are often conflated: which parameters should be updated initially, and whether that choice should remain fixed as optimization changes the model. We formalized these decisions separately. Intervention Score supplies an objective-conditioned initial support, while selective DIR-R tests whether a checkpoint justifies revising that support.
blocks.zh: 本地化的LLM不学习涉及两个常常被拼凑起来的决定:哪些参数最初应该更新,以及选择是否应该随着优化改变模型而保持固定. 我们分别将这些决定正式化。 干预分数提供客观条件的初步支持,而选择性的DIR-R测试检查站是否有理由修订这种支持。

blocks.en: The evaluations clarify both the value and the limits of this decomposition. The controlled study shows that accurate storage localization can fail to identify the better intervention. Natural-TOFU provides broad descriptive evidence across ten parameter-selection baselines, while the direct LACUNA comparisons show positive mean margins under NPO and SimNPO. The GradDiff results add an important qualification: external static rankings vary by data field and seed, and several static methods remain ahead in the four-field primary. Against its own Static-IV reference, however, DIR-R has a positive aggregate mean difference in every reported evaluation set while invoking the complete continuation comparison only after a trigger. Localized unlearning should therefore treat support selection as a decision about the effect of an update, report where that decision is unstable, and evaluate checkpoint-dependent revision separately from initial localization quality. This framing permits stronger claims where comparisons are direct without hiding boundary cases where method orderings change. Future work should test learned candidate families and multi-checkpoint gates under stronger forgetting attacks and measured wall-clock constraints. The central question is not only where target information is found, but whether updating those parameters improves forgetting without unacceptable collateral damage at the current model state. This makes support control a distinct design and evaluation problem.
blocks.zh: 评价澄清了这种分解的价值和限度。 受控研究表明,准确存储本地化可能无法识别出更好的干预. blocks.en: The audited results support three distinct empirical conclusions. First, Intervention Score has positive mean gaps against several parameter-selection methods, but neither Natural-TOFU nor GradDiff supports universal static dominance. Second, LACUNA NPO/SimNPO has positive mean margins in all six reported baseline comparisons. Third, the aggregate DIR-R-minus- Static-IV mean is positive in each reported DIR-R evaluation set, including both GradDiff evaluation sets in which the external static parameter-selection ordering is field- and seed-sensitive. The data therefore support a decomposition between initial intervention selection and checkpoint-dependent revision rather than a claim that one parameter-selection method or DIR-R dominates every setting.
blocks.zh: 审计的结果支持三个截然不同的经验结论。 首先,干预得分对若干参数选择方法有积极的平均差距,但Natural-TOFU和GradDiff都支持普遍静态支配. 第二,在所报告的所有6个基线比较中,拉加办事处/非营利组织有正差。 第三,DIR-R-减-静态-IV总平均值在每套报告DIR-R评价中呈正数,包括GradDiff评价集,其中外部静态参数选择定单对野外和种子敏感。 因此,这些数据支持在初始干预选择和依赖检查站的修订之间进行分解,而不是声称一个参数选择方法或DIR-R主导每个设置。
